review_scope: Technical comparison of all 23 Forward+ pairs against tracked main. Normalized materials matched by stable named draw paths for selected lighting deltas. The controlled F03 lamp trial separately verifies the live depth mask and compositor passes.

images.observation: Ceiling pendant, work table, floor boards and doorway remain readable within the warm room lighting.
The tiled spotlight pool, curtain and fixture outlines remain visible in the reflected room.
Resident, window, table and chairs retain their draw order and shape. The companion display and rim light remain legible.
The beam falls on the same desk and window assembly with boards and foreground chair retained.
The beam edge and cabinet-wall lighting vary across the pair. Cabinet, backsplash, sink and all 11 matched named material records remain present.
Boiler gauge, piping, door and feet retain their offsets and shadow shapes.
Bookcase, ladder, shelves and doorway retain their outlines in the dark alcove.
Tile seams, vertical vent edge and nearby fittings remain continuous.
Brick joints and stone faces remain visible in the unlit shaft crop.
The panel door and conduits pick up warmer reflections. Sockets and labels remain separated and all 24 matched named material records agree.
The rail, tiled floor and framing retain the same silhouettes and surface separation.
Figure, molding, frame and wall retain the low bar lighting and clear boundaries.
Shelf trim, wall frames and rear practical remain visible.
The bank, card rows and bench remain present. Reflections are slightly more uniform across the bank, and matched lettering and card materials agree.
Fins, pipes, blind and nearby clock remain aligned. All 26 matched named radiator materials agree.
Rail uprights, strings of fittings and drive-room door remain continuous under the warm landing light.
The tank, roof rail and skyline retain their silhouettes and mapped surfaces.
Register lid and wall highlights vary within the warm exposure. Counter and slips stay present and all 55 matched named register draws retain their materials.
The warm light still defines the tile grid and visible fixture edges.
The colored residue, radiator and wood are distinct inside the real beam and companion remains visible.

Ambient fill on the curtain and tabletop is warmer and brighter in the candidate. The beam footprint, installed radiator and tentacle outlines are retained. Assessment uses the physical-surface contract and the paired live depth scope for their respective tests.
The face, crumbs, cans and nearby counter retain their edges. All 11 matched named toaster material records agree.
The candidate has less wall fill and a warmer bright edge. The station plate and latch stay distinct and all 83 matched named watch-area material records agree.
